advancements.doctor_m.root.title: DOCTOR M
advancements.doctor_m.root.description: Why is it called DOCTOR M? En... DOCTOR MOD, DOCTOR MC, anyway, it has multiple meanings~
advancements.doctor_m.enter_trenzalore.d: In a snow-covered town, an aged warrior is about to face his final hour, and his glorious old body is about to begin a new chapter.
message.doctor_m.rassilon_key.tooltip.li: Apart from Rassilon himself, no Time Lord President has ever obtained the Key of Rassilon...
message.doctor_m.de_mat_gun.tooltip.line: Destroy this gun, destroy all its data, and do not let its immense power corrupt your mind...
message.doctor_m.time_key_resurrection: §bThe power of the Time Key has reversed your death
message.doctor_m.time_key.tip: The complete Time Key... It exists at all points in time, granting its holder access to the 'heart' of the universe.
message.doctor_m.pocket_watch.tip: A golden pocket watch... It possesses a portion of the Time Key's power, capable of reversing the player's death...
message.doctor_m.time_key.neutral_tip: §7Sneak + Right Click to enable Forced Neutral Mode
message.doctor_m.pocket_watch.revived: §dAn item on your person has reversed your death..
